notes: packer_skill = SKILL.md plus bundled scripts/load_plan.py; step1_skill = guidance-only skill from iteration-1 (same 8 runs, regraded).
Large 49-PO shipment: both packer runs reached the planted 8 (Sonnet in 92 s); step-1 Sonnet stopped at 9.
Reported 22-PO shipment: 3 containers in 4/4 runs for both; packer runs took 0.4 to 16 min vs 13 to 84 min.

Oversize shipment: both packer runs asked before splitting (as the skill said) but estimated the split total instead of running it, failing the count check. Fixed in the skill and verified in iteration-3: 2/2 quote the planner's split total of 8.
Claim checks (false impossibility, tolerance, oversize flag, no silent split) passed in all 16 plans: no longer discriminating after step 1.
Tokens -28%. Time comparison is confounded: 8 concurrent runs here vs 12 in iteration-1, and some runs idled on their own background searches.
Blinding was partial: 7 packer plans mention the bundled planner by name.
